description: Python source code defining a dataset mapper class and related functions for object detection data preprocessing in Detectron2, specifically tailored for DETR model integration.

classes.name: DetrDatasetMapper
classes.description: A callable class that maps dataset dictionaries into a format suitable for DETR, including image transformations and annotation processing.

methods.name: build_transform_gen
methods.description: Creates a list of transformation generators based on configuration and training mode.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the DetrDatasetMapper with configuration, setting up cropping and transformation parameters.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Processes a dataset dictionary: reads image, applies transformations, handles annotations, and returns the processed dataset.
